remarks: Step into effortless style and modern comfort in this stunning 2-bedroom, 1-bath ground-level condo. Designed to impress, the sleek quartz countertops with a dramatic waterfall edge set the tone for a space that feels both elevated and inviting. The modern inspired bathroom features a chic walk-in shower, offering a daily escape right at home. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with your own private patio-perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding. This well-maintained complex has been thoughtfully updated with new decks, roofs, and siding, and a paved parking lot delivering fresh curb appeal and lasting value. Convenience meets lifestyle with a dedicated storage unit, one reserved parking space, and plenty of visitor parking. Just minutes from premier shopping, dining, beaches, boating, and cultural attractions, this location offers the best of coastal living. With easy access to nearby train stations, your commute is as effortless as your surroundings.
